items.title: Fruit Salad 🍎
items.fact: Helping others can increase our own happiness and well-being.
items.topic_type: kindness and standing up for others
narration: I'm making a fruit salad, but what's the secret ingredient? It's love and kindness.
When we help others, it can make us feel happy and fulfilled. Look closely at the fruits!
Research shows that acts of kindness can increase our oxytocin levels, the happy hormone. I add a dash of kindness!
By helping others, we can build stronger relationships and a sense of community. Now, let's mix it up!
So, remember to spread kindness and love, just like I do with my fruit salad. See you tomorrow, friends!
items.description:
Join Grandma Halmoni as she makes a delicious fruit salad with a secret ingredient - kindness! What's your favorite way to spread kindness and love? Share with us in the comments!

Today's fun fact: Helping others can increase our own happiness and well-being.

items.title: Stormy Dance 🌪
items.fact: Thunderstorms on Earth can be thousands of times stronger than those on Mars.
items.activity: watching a thunderstorm safely from the porch
narration: What's the wildest weather in our universe?
I love watching thunderstorms from my cozy porch!
Che bello! The thunder is like a big drumbeat!
Did you know thunderstorms on Earth are much stronger than those on Mars?
Stay curious, stay safe, and we'll see you tomorrow!

items.title: Teddy's Boo Boo 🐻
items.fact: The human body can heal itself with the help of white blood cells fighting infection.
items.activity: putting a bandage on a scraped teddy bear (pretend doctor)
narration: What helps our body heal when we get a boo boo?
I'm playing doctor with my teddy bear friend.
Just like our skin heals, our bones can mend too.
White blood cells are like little warriors that fight off the bad guys.
Shall we find out more tomorrow?
